`bb work-board show KEY` and `create` print this link ready to copy.
Use `::task{key="EXA-12"}` on its own line only when the person needs the live status card.

When you take a task from Backlog or Todo, move it as `bb work-board show` suggests (In progress, or the planning status when the project requires a plan) before you start; its epic follows automatically.
Agents can add/remove links with `bb work-board dependency add KEY --blocked-by OTHER` and `dependency remove KEY --blocked-by OTHER`.

If a card you work on shows a `Plan debt` advisory (in `bb work-board show KEY`), it is in work without an approved plan: write the plan and submit it with `bb work-board plan submit KEY --reviewer …` now.
Work Board reminds the card's executors after a decision is answered, a PR is linked and 24 h; `bb work-board list --plan-debt` lists such cards.
One question asks one decision or one check in one or two short plain sentences, with at most one link.
Put what the owner has to do in `--step` (repeat it; the steps show as a numbered list under the question), not in a comment.
Split a multi-part acceptance into several `--kind check` questions, each answerable on its own with its own link.
Evidence, tables, quotes of earlier remarks, inventories and history go into a task comment, not the question.
Acceptance material is a link to a local design server or the product, never screenshots.

When an existing check's state changes, never add a parallel check: edit an open one with `question update`, `--reopen` an answered one whose prompt and steps are unchanged, and replace it after any changed link or step with `bb work-board question add KEY --kind check --supersedes ID --supersedes-revision N`.
Start the new prompt with what changed since the previous check.
A question that no longer matters, for example on a card you are canceling, is closed with `question withdraw` and a reason; never answer it yourself.
